frame_envelope_policy: fixed 48x64 cell is allowed only if corrected model sheet and lineart blocking prove no hair, hand, foot, lava arm, strike or recovery clipping

scale_targets.head_height_px: 10-14 including hair mass at sprite scale
scale_targets.face_cluster_goal: eyes and brow remain readable with 2-4 pixels of intentional contrast
scale_targets.hand_endpoint_goal: human fist, wrapped hand and lava hand each have distinct silhouette families

pivot_rules: idle, walk_step, guard_block, jab and knee keep bottom-center pivot stable.
teep keeps support foot on ground_y; kicking leg may extend but cannot force frame edge clipping.
hurt preserves scale and ground_y, with head/torso reacting to force instead of full-body resize.
Any scale change after lineart blocking requires reseed and this contract must be rewritten.
